title: Neon Dash: Survive the Dash
desc: Neon Dash: Survive the Dash is a high-octane, rhythm-based platformer where precision is everything. Navigate a gritty, dark-pop world filled with lethal spikes, rotating sawblades, and shifting gravity. Use jump pads and mid-air orbs to defy death as the speed intensifies across multiple neon-drenched levels. Experience cinematic visuals with a pulse-pounding aesthetic designed for those with lightning-fast reflexes. Can you survive the dash?
howto: Jump Tap the screen or press SPACE UP to leap over hazards Mid-Air Orbs Tap while near Cyan Yellow Rings to perform a second jump in mid-air Jump Pads Contact Yellow Pink Pads for an automatic high-velocity boost Portals Pass through Speed Gate
tips: Read the next obstacle early before making a move.
Use small, steady inputs instead of overcorrecting.
Restart quickly and learn the pattern one attempt at a time.
